label: WOWPASS: overseas card networks accepted for top-up
appliesTo: Visitors and new arrivals using a Korean prepaid card before opening a bank account
why: Prepaid cards aimed at foreign visitors change their top-up methods, fees and supported networks often, which is exactly why the supported-network count belongs in a dated record rather than in the body of an article that will be read for years. The useful property of these cards is structural and more stable: money loaded from an overseas card is spent as a domestic card, so it clears at merchants that decline the overseas card outright.

history.note: Mobile top-up using an overseas-issued card, alongside foreign cash top-up at machines. The balance is then spent as a domestic prepaid card at offline merchants. The payment balance and the T-money transport balance are separate: a funded payment balance does not pay a bus or subway fare. Fees, limits and supported networks change — confirm in the app before relying on any of them.
